evidence.description: The datasheet describes manual manager EPS collection and separate author/assistant training and holdout samples.
evidence.quote:
We developed a python script to search each earnings announcement (hereafter, “filing”) for non-
GAAP keywords, and process the resulting output in SAS to construct an indicator for whether the
filing contains a non-GAAP EPS disclosure. For earnings announcements that have non-GAAP
EPS, research assistants read sentences that we identified as containing non-GAAP EPS numbers
and collected the EPS numbers from the sentences. This hand collection took place between April
2015 and February 2018. Appendix B in the paper describes the python script and hand collection
procedures in more detail.

To test the accuracy of our non-GAAP EPS data, the authors hand collected non-GAAP EPS data
from the 568 observations in the Training Sample presented in Table 2. Each author completed a
portion of the hand collection. This hand collection was part of an iterative process while the paper
developed. Research assistants collected non-GAAP EPS data for the 211 observations in the
Holdout Sample presented in Table 2. This Holdout Sample was collected in January 2014, but
this collection did not have the actual non-GAAP EPS numbers. These were collected in October
2016 by research assistants. Originally, the Holdout Sample was 250 observations, but we decided
to omit REITs from the sample, based on observations from the Training Sample. This reduced
the Holdout Sample to 211 observations.

Map each author library alias to an exact local or authorized WRDS product; do not substitute current Compustat for the explicitly requested point-in-time products.
Confirm filing-date, historical-link, fiscal-period, and executive-role fields used at the cited code lines.
validation: Record exact product, fields, version, and required periods/histories for every distinct table.

actions.description: Acquire the target-period SEC company indexes and raw 8-K text through the official public archive.
steps: Obtain company indexes and complete raw 8-K text for 2003–2013.
Use index paths and a declared User-Agent, observing SEC fair-access limits.
Preserve identifiers and raw filing text required by author parsers.
validation: Compare index fields and filing paths with code inputs.
Verify 8-K and section/text coverage for the target acquisition period.

actions.description: Resolve each manager annotation version and sign-correction table as a distinct required input.
steps: Confirm the source and fields for hc_sent, hc_sent_v2, hc_sent_v3, and hc_sent_both_v2 separately.
Confirm the independent handcollect_fix_neg_signs fields and correction history.
Treat the author Manager Non-GAAP EPS form as a conditional lead only until its match to each exact input is established.
validation: Check each table’s filename key, manager EPS values, multiple/GAAP-only fields, sign handling, and target-period coverage.

actions.description: Identify each separate post-sample accuracy-validation input.
steps: Confirm whether the full run includes the Hand Collection Master, Venn-diagram table, and Holdout Sample branch.
If included, obtain or identify each exact source separately with its source/coverage fields.
validation: Confirm each input joins on the filename key and preserves the cited training/holdout definitions.

actions.description: Establish SAS/CONNECT, library aliases, remote authentication, and working-directory/path configuration.
steps: Confirm SAS/CONNECT and configure COMPM, CRSPQ, COMPSNAP, IBES, STORAGE, KOOLAID, and TEMP librefs.
Set SAS user-file root and Python current directory so Filings/, list files, dictionaries, and outputs resolve.
validation: Resolve all required tables/paths before considering code runnable.

actions.description: Provide a compatible runtime for Python 2.7/urllib2 scripts or prepare a reviewed Python 3 migration.
steps: Choose an isolated compatible Python 2.7 runtime or review and port urllib2 and text/file behavior to a supported runtime.
validation: Check imports and compare output schemas for downloads, word counts, EPS flags, and sentence files.

actions.description: Locate and verify the custom SAS macro library expected by the supplied code.
steps: Identify the definitions and versions of %dupl, %ff48, and %winsorize_truncate.
Map them into SAS without changing author code until behavior is confirmed.
validation: Confirm macro parameters and duplicate, industry, and truncation behavior.

actions.description: Activate the exact EDGAR WORK-to-STORAGE copy already supplied in the producer.
steps: Configure the STORAGE libref.

Activate the supplied data storage.Edgar_Filings_1993to2013; set Edgar_Filings_1993to2013; run; statements at source lines 53–55 by removing their surrounding comment delimiters or executing those statements after the macro.
Run the downstream SEC join only after that exact persistent table exists.
validation: Confirm the persistent table name/fields and row count match the EDGAR WORK table.
Confirm the downstream SET statement reads the produced table.

actions.description: Prepare lossless, stage-specific six-file views from filinglist_full.txt without changing filing membership.
steps: Preserve the two-column id/url source export with its original order.
If a filing ID occurs more than once, keep all matching IDs within the same operational chunk and verify whether IDs are unique before any file-name-based download; never drop duplicate rows.
Split the source into six operational chunks without changing filing membership. Create headerless Python views because DownloadFilings.py processes every CSV row.
Create corresponding headered SAS views because Identify EA Announcements v2.2.sas reads filename/extension with FIRSTOBS=2. Keep every data row and order identical across stage views.
Use stage-specific directories and expected basenames coherently at each call, checking text_file[11:] naming for Filings and WordCount outputs. Keep the author EA 8-K component separate.
validation: Verify each original id/url row appears exactly once in the six chunk set; duplicated IDs remain together and are not silently overwritten.
Verify no Python header is treated as a filing and no SAS first data row is skipped.
Verify every input/output basename agrees with text_file[11:] and the current directory/path each script resolves.
Confirm six WordCount outputs use the names and tab-separated schema consumed by the SAS importer.

actions.description: Use exact supplied Part II filename and preserve main → Part II → final order.
steps: Use _nested_Code/Code/KoolAid_Analysis_v11.3_PartII.sas after KoolAid_Analysis_v11.6.sas.
Pass koolaid.sample_partII to KoolAid_Final_v5.13.sas.
validation: Confirm Part II output keys match the final program’s gvkey/datadate join.

review_notes: This is the expanded source/resource checkpoint; the remaining frozen dependencies are being mapped incrementally before finalization.

All 14 exact packaged SAS/Python paths are retained. README Part II filename differs from the supplied _nested_Code/Code/KoolAid_Analysis_v11.3_PartII.sas; the supplied file is used because its sample_partII output is consumed by the final program.
The frozen identifier list was inspected only at its header, first three rows, total line/record count, and frozen hash; it is not a prepared analysis panel.
One-row SAS probes establish only readable candidate files and requested fields. They do not verify historical population coverage, alias mapping, license entitlement, or point-in-time equivalence.
No author code was run or imported, no datasets were downloaded or deserialized, no packages were installed, and no external author forms were submitted.

Resource requirements are split by every jointly required table and packaged dictionary. Standard local Compustat, CRSP, and I/B/E/S products are verified at the exact field/readability level; only explicit PIT/unrestated/history/identifier products remain unresolved.

Author Manager Non-GAAP EPS form remains a conditional candidate for the specific hand-collected tables. The author Earnings Announcement 8-K form is an optional lead only: supplied Identify EA Announcements v2.2.sas creates koolaid.EAs_2003to2013 at lines 235–240, so that form is not a mandatory input.
README’s approximately 300 GB and more-than-one-week warnings are author estimates; no local run was measured.

The first bounded COMP.FUNDQ request included SICH, which is a FUNDA field and is absent from the FUNDQ catalog. The helper rejected that field before reading rows; this is not evidence of missing data. The corrected successful FUNDQ probe omits SICH and is the only probe cited for the local route.
Entry points retain the README preparation order and use the exact supplied PartII filename after the v11.6 main analysis and before final assembly.
